source.text_it: Le masse centrifughe che innestano la frizione automatica non si spostano quando i giri del motore aumentano

records.localized_text: Centrifugal weights engaging an automatic clutch do not move when engine rpm increases.

source.text_it: Un veicolo dotato di frizione automatica ha sempre una portata minore di un veicolo a frizione comandata dal conducente

records.localized_text: A vehicle with an automatic clutch always has a lower payload than one with a driver-operated clutch.

source.text_it: L'innesto della frizione automatica può avvenire tramite lo spostamento di leve telescopiche

records.localized_text: An automatic clutch may engage through movement of telescopic levers.

source.text_it: Il disinnesto della frizione automatica avviene tramite lo spostamento di giunti cardanici

records.localized_text: An automatic clutch disengages through movement of universal joints.

source.text_it: L'innesto della frizione automatica può essere solo di tipo idraulico

records.localized_text: An automatic clutch can engage only hydraulically.

source.text_it: Il comando idraulico della frizione migliora la stabilità del veicolo in curva

records.localized_text: Hydraulic clutch control improves vehicle stability on bends.

source.text_it: Il comando idraulico della frizione sfrutta la pressione dell'aria per ridurre lo sforzo del conducente

records.localized_text: Hydraulic clutch control uses air pressure to reduce driver effort.

source.text_it: La frizione consente di connettere e disconnettere gradualmente il motore con la pompa di iniezione

records.localized_text: The clutch gradually connects and disconnects the engine and injection pump.

source.text_it: La frizione non consente di cambiare marcia quando il veicolo è in movimento

records.localized_text: The clutch does not allow gear changes while the vehicle is moving.

source.text_it: Il comando idraulico della frizione sfrutta la pressione dell'olio motore per ridurre lo sforzo del conducente

records.localized_text: Hydraulic clutch control uses engine oil pressure to reduce driver effort.

source.text_it: La frizione si dice "innestata" quando il pedale che la comanda è abbassato

records.localized_text: The clutch is engaged when its control pedal is down.

source.text_it: La frizione si dice "innestata" quando il pedale che la comanda è premuto a fondo dal conducente

records.localized_text: The clutch is engaged when its pedal is fully pressed by the driver.

source.text_it: Tutti i veicoli che non sono dotati di pedale della frizione sono detti "a presa diretta"

records.localized_text: All vehicles without a clutch pedal are called direct-drive vehicles.

source.text_it: Lo spingidisco fa parte dei componenti della frizione

records.localized_text: The pressure plate is a clutch component.

source.text_it: Il piatto spingidisco fa parte degli organi di trasmissione

records.localized_text: The pressure plate is a transmission component.

source.text_it: Il comando idraulico della frizione consente di ridurre lo sforzo del conducente

records.localized_text: Hydraulic clutch control reduces driver effort.

source.text_it: Se il veicolo è dotato di frizione automatica il pedale della frizione non esiste

records.localized_text: A vehicle with an automatic clutch has no clutch pedal.

source.text_it: In tutti gli autoveicoli è presente il pedale della frizione

records.localized_text: All motor vehicles have a clutch pedal.

source.text_it: Lo spingidisco fa parte dei componenti del differenziale

records.localized_text: The pressure plate is a differential component.

source.text_it: Lo spingidisco fa parte dei componenti dei freni a tamburo

records.localized_text: The pressure plate is a drum brake component.

source.text_it: Il disco della frizione non deve mai entrare in contatto col volano

records.localized_text: The clutch disc must never contact the flywheel.

source.text_it: Il piatto spingidisco fa parte degli organi di sospensione

records.localized_text: The pressure plate is a suspension component.

source.text_it: Il piatto spingidisco fa parte degli organi di frenatura

records.localized_text: The pressure plate is a braking component.

source.text_it: La frizione può essere del tipo a dischi variabili

records.localized_text: A clutch may be a variable-disc type.

source.text_it: La frizione a dischi multipli può essere a secco oppure a bagno d'acqua

records.localized_text: A multi-disc clutch may be dry or run in a water bath.

rows.text: In a centrifugal clutch, increasing speed moves the weights outward; once they overcome the springs, they engage the clutch.
evidence: Amsbeck, Centrifugal clutches, Functional principle and Engagement, https://www.amsbeck-mt.de/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/Amsbeck-Centrifugal-clutches.pdf: rotating weights move outward and overcome spring force to engage.

rows.text: Payload depends on the permitted masses and the vehicle’s mass; the clutch control type alone does not always make it lower.
evidence: GOV.UK, Vehicle weights explained, https://www.gov.uk/vehicle-weights-explained: maximum authorised mass includes vehicle and maximum load; running mass is the vehicle ready for use.

Eaton, UltraShift DM Clutch, https://origin-edge.eaton.com/us/en-us/catalog/clutches-and-brakes/ultrashift-dm-centrifugal-clutch.html: centrifugal automatic clutch engages and disengages without a clutch pedal; single- and two-plate versions.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE, but does not define “telescopic levers”. In one documented centrifugal clutch, weights move with speed and overcome springs to engage it; this example does not rule out every other mechanism.
evidence: Official superiori question 29713 retains its printed verdict.
Amsbeck centrifugal clutches https://www.amsbeck-mt.de/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/Amsbeck-Centrifugal-clutches.pdf : weights and springs example; no universal exclusion inferred.

rows.text: In a centrifugal clutch, disengagement depends on speed falling and the springs returning the weights, not on movement of universal joints.
evidence: Amsbeck, Centrifugal clutches, Functional principle and Engagement, https://www.amsbeck-mt.de/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/Amsbeck-Centrifugal-clutches.pdf: rotating weights move outward and overcome spring force to engage.

rows.text: Automatic engagement is not exclusively hydraulic: rotating centrifugal weights can also engage the clutch.
evidence: Amsbeck, Centrifugal clutches, Functional principle and Engagement, https://www.amsbeck-mt.de/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/Amsbeck-Centrifugal-clutches.pdf: rotating weights move outward and overcome spring force to engage.

Eaton, UltraShift DM Clutch, https://origin-edge.eaton.com/us/en-us/catalog/clutches-and-brakes/ultrashift-dm-centrifugal-clutch.html: centrifugal automatic clutch engages and disengages without a clutch pedal; single- and two-plate versions.

rows.text: Hydraulic control transmits pedal movement to disengage the clutch; it is not a device intended to improve cornering stability.
evidence: ZF Aftermarket, Clutches, Function of master/slave cylinder, https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/our-portfolio/passenger-cars/products/clutches/: pedal-operated master cylinder creates pressure in a closed hydraulic circuit to operate the slave cylinder and release the clutch.

rows.text: Hydraulic control transmits pressure through liquid in the circuit, not through air pressure.
evidence: ZF Aftermarket, Clutches, Function of master/slave cylinder, https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/our-portfolio/passenger-cars/products/clutches/: pedal-operated master cylinder creates pressure in a closed hydraulic circuit to operate the slave cylinder and release the clutch.

rows.text: The clutch connects and separates the engine and transmission, not the injection pump; it permits gradual engagement.
evidence: ZF, Clutch Systems, The Technology, https://www.zf.com/products/pl/cv/products_65885.html?pageLink=gallery_divider658792: pressure plate presses the clutch disc against the flywheel and transmits engine torque to the transmission input.

Eaton, UltraShift DM Clutch, https://origin-edge.eaton.com/us/en-us/catalog/clutches-and-brakes/ultrashift-dm-centrifugal-clutch.html: centrifugal automatic clutch engages and disengages without a clutch pedal; single- and two-plate versions.

rows.text: Disengaging the clutch interrupts the connection to the transmission, making gear changes easier even while moving.
evidence: ZF Aftermarket, Clutches, Function of master/slave cylinder, https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/our-portfolio/passenger-cars/products/clutches/: pedal-operated master cylinder creates pressure in a closed hydraulic circuit to operate the slave cylinder and release the clutch.

ZF, Clutch Systems, The Technology, https://www.zf.com/products/pl/cv/products_65885.html?pageLink=gallery_divider658792: pressure plate presses the clutch disc against the flywheel and transmits engine torque to the transmission input.

rows.text: In hydraulic control, pressure is generated by the pedal-operated cylinder in a hydraulic circuit; it is not engine oil pressure.
evidence: ZF Aftermarket, Clutches, Function of master/slave cylinder, https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/our-portfolio/passenger-cars/products/clutches/: pedal-operated master cylinder creates pressure in a closed hydraulic circuit to operate the slave cylinder and release the clutch.

rows.text: Pressing the pedal disengages the clutch; with the pedal released, the clutch is normally engaged and transmits torque.
evidence: ZF Aftermarket, Clutches, Function of master/slave cylinder, https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/our-portfolio/passenger-cars/products/clutches/: pedal-operated master cylinder creates pressure in a closed hydraulic circuit to operate the slave cylinder and release the clutch.

ZF, Clutch Systems, The Technology, https://www.zf.com/products/pl/cv/products_65885.html?pageLink=gallery_divider658792: pressure plate presses the clutch disc against the flywheel and transmits engine torque to the transmission input.

rows.text: With the pedal fully pressed, the clutch is disengaged; when released, it is normally engaged and transmits torque.
evidence: ZF Aftermarket, Clutches, Function of master/slave cylinder, https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/our-portfolio/passenger-cars/products/clutches/: pedal-operated master cylinder creates pressure in a closed hydraulic circuit to operate the slave cylinder and release the clutch.

ZF, Clutch Systems, The Technology, https://www.zf.com/products/pl/cv/products_65885.html?pageLink=gallery_divider658792: pressure plate presses the clutch disc against the flywheel and transmits engine torque to the transmission input.

rows.text: Having no pedal does not imply direct drive: an automated gearbox can control the clutch automatically and have several gears.
evidence: Eaton, UltraShift DM Clutch, https://origin-edge.eaton.com/us/en-us/catalog/clutches-and-brakes/ultrashift-dm-centrifugal-clutch.html: centrifugal automatic clutch engages and disengages without a clutch pedal; single- and two-plate versions.

Eaton, UltraShift driver instructions, introduction, https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/transmissions/vehicle-transmissions/driver-instructions/eaton-fuller-transmission-trdr-0082-driver-instructions-en-us.pdf: automated shifting uses a manual transmission without a clutch pedal.

rows.text: The pressure plate presses the clutch disc against the flywheel, allowing torque to be transmitted.
evidence: ZF, Clutch Systems, The Technology, https://www.zf.com/products/pl/cv/products_65885.html?pageLink=gallery_divider658792: pressure plate presses the clutch disc against the flywheel and transmits engine torque to the transmission input.

rows.text: The pressure plate belongs to the clutch, which transmits engine torque to the gearbox input shaft.
evidence: ZF, Clutch Systems, The Technology, https://www.zf.com/products/pl/cv/products_65885.html?pageLink=gallery_divider658792: pressure plate presses the clutch disc against the flywheel and transmits engine torque to the transmission input.

rows.text: The hydraulic control transmits pressure from the master cylinder to the slave cylinder. Suitable control ratios can reduce the force needed at the pedal while allowing for the required travel.
evidence: FTE automotive, Hydraulic Clutch Actuation Basics, Principle, p. 18, https://www.aligas.com/storage/app/media/catalogos/manual%20fte.pdf: pedal, master cylinder and slave cylinder transmit force; hydraulic and mechanical ratios multiply foot force and are selected for pedal effort and travel.

rows.text: An automatic clutch engages and disengages without requiring a driver-operated clutch pedal.
evidence: Eaton, UltraShift DM Clutch, https://origin-edge.eaton.com/us/en-us/catalog/clutches-and-brakes/ultrashift-dm-centrifugal-clutch.html: centrifugal automatic clutch engages and disengages without a clutch pedal; single- and two-plate versions.

rows.text: Not all motor vehicles have a clutch pedal: systems with an automatic clutch can operate without one.
evidence: Eaton, UltraShift DM Clutch, https://origin-edge.eaton.com/us/en-us/catalog/clutches-and-brakes/ultrashift-dm-centrifugal-clutch.html: centrifugal automatic clutch engages and disengages without a clutch pedal; single- and two-plate versions.

rows.text: The pressure plate is part of the clutch: it presses the disc against the flywheel to transmit torque; it is not part of the differential.
evidence: ZF, Clutch Systems, The Technology, https://www.zf.com/products/pl/cv/products_65885.html?pageLink=gallery_divider658792: pressure plate presses the clutch disc against the flywheel and transmits engine torque to the transmission input.

rows.text: The pressure plate belongs to the clutch and presses its disc against the flywheel; it is not a drum brake component.
evidence: ZF, Clutch Systems, The Technology, https://www.zf.com/products/pl/cv/products_65885.html?pageLink=gallery_divider658792: pressure plate presses the clutch disc against the flywheel and transmits engine torque to the transmission input.

rows.text: When the clutch is engaged, the pressure plate presses the disc against the flywheel: contact allows torque to be transmitted.
evidence: ZF, Clutch Systems, The Technology, https://www.zf.com/products/pl/cv/products_65885.html?pageLink=gallery_divider658792: pressure plate presses the clutch disc against the flywheel and transmits engine torque to the transmission input.

rows.text: The pressure plate belongs to the clutch and thus the drivetrain, not the suspension.
evidence: ZF, Clutch Systems, The Technology, https://www.zf.com/products/pl/cv/products_65885.html?pageLink=gallery_divider658792: pressure plate presses the clutch disc against the flywheel and transmits engine torque to the transmission input.

rows.text: The pressure plate belongs to the clutch and transmits torque; it is not a braking component.
evidence: ZF, Clutch Systems, The Technology, https://www.zf.com/products/pl/cv/products_65885.html?pageLink=gallery_divider658792: pressure plate presses the clutch disc against the flywheel and transmits engine torque to the transmission input.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE, but the sources do not define “variable discs”. Single-plate and multi-plate clutches exist; these examples alone do not prove every other type impossible.
evidence: Official superiori question 29734 retains its printed verdict.

Eaton https://origin-edge.eaton.com/us/en-us/catalog/clutches-and-brakes/ultrashift-dm-centrifugal-clutch.html and Stüwe https://stuewe-ag.ch/en/multiple-disc-clutches/ : examples of clutch designs, not a definition of quiz term.

rows.text: For vehicle multi-disc clutches, the distinction is between dry operation and an oil bath: the liquid used in a wet clutch is oil, not water.
evidence: Stüwe, Multi-plate clutches, https://stuewe-ag.ch/en/multiple-disc-clutches/: multi-plate clutches operate dry or in an oil bath.

Yuji Fujii, Clutch Wet, Wiley Encyclopedia of Automotive Engineering, 2014, https://doi.org/10.1002/9781118354179.auto090: a vehicle wet clutch is an oil-lubricated friction device. Teaching scope is vehicle dry and oil-lubricated clutches, not a universal claim about every conceivable design.

reviewer_evidence: Amsbeck centrifugal clutch and Stüwe multiple-plate source independently inspected. 29713/29734 explicitly record unresolved terminology rather than claiming impossible alternatives.

issues.reason: The official FALSO asserts that automatic clutch engagement cannot occur by displacement of telescopic levers. The technical source establishes a centrifugal-weight mechanism but does not exclude a telescopic-lever mechanism; the scope and intended meaning of the printed claim remain unverified.
checked_sources: Italian Ministry, superiori quiz no. 29713, https://ilportaledellautomobilista.it/documents/56611/57321/Domande%2BSuperiori%2Bitaliano%2B04%2B04%2B2025/7763ce74-4de6-4ad9-9129-7a7c21efd1fb: prints the claim and FALSO.

Amsbeck, Centrifugal clutches, Functional principle and Engagement, https://www.amsbeck-mt.de/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/Amsbeck-Centrifugal-clutches.pdf: centrifugal weights move outward to engage one design; does not exclude telescopic levers.

issues.reason: The official FALSO rejects a clutch described as a dischi variabili, but the expression has no verified technical definition in the sources found. Examples of single- and multi-disc clutches do not establish that the stated type is impossible or identify the intended distinction.
checked_sources: Italian Ministry, superiori quiz no. 29734, https://ilportaledellautomobilista.it/documents/56611/57321/Domande%2BSuperiori%2Bitaliano%2B04%2B04%2B2025/7763ce74-4de6-4ad9-9129-7a7c21efd1fb: prints the claim and FALSO.

Eaton, UltraShift DM Clutch, https://origin-edge.eaton.com/us/en-us/catalog/clutches-and-brakes/ultrashift-dm-centrifugal-clutch.html: provides single- and two-plate versions, without defining or excluding dischi variabili.
Stüwe, Multi-plate clutches, https://stuewe-ag.ch/en/multiple-disc-clutches/: describes multi-plate clutches, without defining or excluding dischi variabili.

issues.reason: The question asserts that telescopic levers CAN engage an automatic clutch. An example using centrifugal weights and the statement that telescopic levers are not required do not refute that possibility. Amsbeck describes its centrifugal design but does not establish the proposed mechanism is incorrect; provide an authoritative correction addressing the actual claim.

The cited ZF Racing Clutch System PDF could not be inspected: the browser rejected the document as too large. The other cited ZF page establishes hydraulic actuation but does not establish the asserted reduction in pedal force; provide an inspectable authoritative reference supporting the force comparison.

The cited single- and multi-disc examples do not establish that “variable-disc” is not a type of clutch. Supply authoritative evidence for the terminology and explain the decisive distinction; examples alone do not refute the asserted possibility.

Stüwe establishes dry and oil-bath examples, but does not establish the categorical exclusion of a water bath. Support the exclusion with an authoritative vehicle-clutch source or qualify the teaching claim to the verified scope while explaining the printed verdict.
